_comment: 2015 MINI Cooper S Hardtop 2-door (F56, US): 2.0 L B48 turbo four, 6-speed manual, front-wheel drive. Model: CARLA Team's Mini Cooper (carla-content, CC BY 4.0), exported from Unreal to glTF.
name: Cooper S

sources.mass: 2,785 lb, 2015 Cooper S manual (KBB). Split 62/38 and CG 0.53 m are estimates.
sources.engine: MINI US: 189 hp at 4700-6000 rpm, 207 lb-ft at 1250-4750 rpm; overboost 221 lb-ft not modelled. Curve outside the plateau is an estimate.
sources.gearing: GS6-59SG ratios and 3.588 final drive from the NAM forum (secondary); 6th checked against an owner report of 2800 rpm at 75 mph. Reverse is an estimate.
sources.brakes: 294 mm vented front, 259 mm solid rear (Brembo catalogue). Torques are estimates. Rear share 0.27 exceeds the ideal above 0.5 g; EBD in ABS/DSC holds the rear, as on the real car.
sources.diff: Open differential with brake-based EDLC (MINI). EDLC is not modelled; traction control stands in.
sources.steering: 14.2:1 Servotronic EPS, 10.8 m circle (MINI media info); 2.4 turns from the forum (unverified).
sources.aero: Cd 0.31 x 2.09 m2 = 0.65 m2 (MINI media information 03/2015).
sources.calibration: Car and Driver 2014 Cooper S Hardtop: 6.6 s, 172 ft, 0.91 g (Yahoo reprint; transmission not confirmed).
sources.estimates: Weight split, CG, inertia, springs, bars, dampers, alignment, brake torques, clutch, ESC gradient, tyre curve, driver eye.
